# aap_eda_project (Data Source)

Get project datasource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aap_eda_project" "example-id" {
  id = "1"
}


data "aap_eda_project" "example-name" {
  name = "Default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the EDA project. Either specify `id` or `name` but not both.
- `name` (String) The name of the EDA project. Either specify `id` or `name` but not both.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the EDA project.
- `eda_credential_id` (Number) The EDA credential ID associated with the EDA project.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization ID for the EDA project.
- `proxy` (String) The proxy server for the EDA project.
- `scm_branch` (String) The SCM branch for the EDA project.
- `scm_refspec` (String) The SCM refspec for the EDA project.
- `scm_type` (String) The SCM type for the EDA project. Currently only `git` is an option.
- `signature_validation_credential_id` (Number) The content signature validation credential ID for the EDA project.
- `url` (String) The SCM URL for the EDA project.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) Whether to verify SSL for the SCM URL.
